translation:
Bareli

Naranadas Khatri lived in Bareli. His doubt (sanshay) of 32 years was removed by Jivanji Maharaj. To get this doubt removed, Naranadas used to run a sadavrat (a free food-distribution charity), and would tell his doubt to every sadhu and sant who came there, but no one was able to resolve it. But when Jivanji Maharaj went there, he removed this doubt. And thus Naranadas Khatri, the very first disciple of Jivanji Maharaj, became an udabhakt (an awakened, foremost devotee). Therefore this Bareli can be counted as one punya sthali (sacred site) in memory of Jivanji Maharaj.
